# Script index

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/docs/build_docs.ts - do not edit by hand; run `bun run docs:build` -->

Every script in `package.json`, run as `bun run <name>` from the repository root (`bun start` and `bun test` also work without `run`). **187 scripts.** Being listed here does not mean the script was run for this handbook; see the [coverage matrix](../documentation-maintenance/coverage-matrix.md) and [Install and first launch](../getting-started/install-and-first-launch.md) for what was verified.
